description: Optional compile-time dependency injection at the factory CLI entrypoint: add cmd/factory/composition with google/wire, register the generated FactoryService builder before cli.Execute, expand providers after S6 collaborator extraction, and preserve all you run and local API server behavior with documented go generate workflow.

context.customerAsk: Optional wire in cmd/ after composition stabilizes. Full spec: tasks/prd-cmd-wire-composition.md — Command Wiring with Wire (S8).
context.problem: FactoryService construction is invoked from pkg/cli/run while process wiring belongs in cmd/. As S6 injects collaborators (factorysave, runtimebuild, sessions, localmodels, hostedworkers), manual edge wiring risks duplication and ordering drift. cmd/factory/main.go is currently a one-line delegate, and pkg cannot import cmd, so Wire must register into the existing buildFactoryService hook from main.
context.solution: Introduce cmd/factory/composition with wire.go (wireinject) and checked-in wire_gen.go that calls plain pkg/service constructors; register the generated builder from cmd/factory/main.go via pkg/cli/run before cli.Execute. Bootstrap by wrapping service.BuildFactoryService, then expand explicit providers after S6. Document go generate workflow and optional CI stale-gen check. No API, CLI flag, or UI behavior changes.

acceptanceCriteria: Wire usage is confined to cmd/factory/composition; pkg/service, pkg/api, and pkg/cli have no wireinject tags and no wire struct tags in production code.
you run and go build ./cmd/factory preserve existing CLI flags, help, defaults, and startup behavior covered by pkg/cli/run tests.
cmd/factory/main.go registers the wire-generated factory builder before cli.Execute; pkg/cli/run tests can still override buildFactoryService without Wire.
wire_gen.go is generated via go generate, committed, and never hand-edited; maintainer docs describe install and regeneration.
After S6, collaborator wiring is expressed in one provider set; adding a dependency does not require parallel manual entrypoint edits.
Existing integration and functional tests for you run and the local API server pass without assertion weakening.
Quality gate: go build ./..., repository lint/typecheck surfaces, and targeted tests for cmd/factory/composition, pkg/cli/run, and pkg/service pass.

pkg/cli/run tests that override buildFactoryService continue to pass without calling the registration function.

userStories.title: Wire toolchain and composition package bootstrap

acceptanceCriteria: github.com/google/wire is available to the repo; cmd/factory/composition/wire.go uses wireinject and go generate to produce wire_gen.go.

wire_gen.go builds without the wireinject tag and exposes a function that builds *service.FactoryService from context.Context and *service.FactoryServiceConfig by delegating to service.BuildFactoryService.
go build ./cmd/factory succeeds on a clean checkout after go generate ./cmd/factory/composition/...

Tests pass

userStories.title: Register wire-built builder in factory main

acceptanceCriteria: cmd/factory/main.go registers the composition package generated builder via pkg/cli/run before cli.Execute().
go test ./pkg/cli/run/... passes with no intentional changes to flag parsing, auto-port, dashboard URL, or API server startup tests.

A focused composition test asserts the registered builder returns non-nil *service.FactoryService for a minimal valid FactoryServiceConfig fixture, or the same error family as service.BuildFactoryService for an invalid fixture.

Tests pass

userStories.title: Explicit collaborator provider set (post-S6)

The wire-generated build path is behaviorally equivalent to service.BuildFactoryService for the same FactoryServiceConfig on fixtures covered by existing pkg/service build tests.
go test ./pkg/service/... and go test ./pkg/cli/run/... pass without weakening assertions.

acceptanceCriteria: docs/internal/development/ or the development guide documents installing Wire CLI, running go generate ./cmd/factory/composition/..., committing wire_gen.go, and never hand-editing generated files.
Documentation states Wire is limited to cmd/factory/composition and pkg/service stays tag-free.
